evals.prompt: A worker finished TASK-0301 and wants to Telegram Kenji: 'Review tickets/TASK-0301/artifacts/report.md'. Prepare the review request.
evals.expected_output: Does not send a local-path-only Telegram message; Requires a phone-readable summary, excerpt, options, or phone-openable link; Labels local filesystem paths as desktop-only when included; Records fallback if the artifact cannot be summarized honestly; Keeps the bound persistent thread as the reply route while releasing the execution worker
assertions: Does not send a local-path-only Telegram message
Requires a phone-readable summary, excerpt, options, or phone-openable link
Labels local filesystem paths as desktop-only when included
Records fallback if the artifact cannot be summarized honestly

farplane.title: Rejects a local-path-only artifact review request
anti_patterns: Pastes a giant report without a clear decision
Creates a new approval queue instead of routing replies to the worker

evals.prompt: A worker has produced an ablation proof report with summary and archive-safe artifact refs. Telegram is configured and CODEX_THREAD_ID is available. What should the finish receipt include?
evals.expected_output: Uses telegram-message as the send route; Includes ticket id, worker thread/session ref, artifact refs, requested reply action, and Telegram message id; Logs a progress.md Review block with artifact refs, thread ref, request time, next reminder time, reminder count, and empty decision; Applies the worker-artifact-review and telegram-message QA checklists; Records a blocker instead of silently succeeding if sending fails; Sets status awaiting_review, clears claimed_by, and releases the execution worker; Does not mark publish/post/spend approval as granted

evals.prompt: TASK-0304 is awaiting_review. Its progress Review block has no decision and next_reminder_at matured yesterday. Work Pulse selected it as the single due reminder. What should happen now?
evals.expected_output: Sends one Telegram reminder using the existing artifact summary and reply route; Increments reminder_count and records the send receipt in progress.md; Sets the next configured reminder time or clears it when capped; Does not assign or reserve an execution worker; Does not use review queue size as a chase trigger; Does not infer phone escalation or final-action approval

Increments reminder_count and records the send receipt in progress.md
Sets the next configured reminder time or clears it when capped
Does not assign or reserve an execution worker

farplane.title: Sends only a due reminder without reserving a worker
anti_patterns: Creates a new approval queue instead of routing the answer to the worker thread

evals.prompt: A worker finished a storyboard and two hook variants for a harness-engineering video. Ask Kenji to review it without posting.
evals.expected_output: Summarizes the storyboard/hook options in Telegram-readable form; Asks one clear reply action such as choose A/B, revise, or reject with reason; States that posting/publishing remains gated; Includes archive-safe artifact refs as desktop-only refs after the reviewable content; Records the request in the caller-owned ticket or progress surface
